review_intent: Judge whether the runtime-to-review pipeline can transfer product geometry and commercial still-life rules from Trial 001 to a non-beauty hard-edge product without real execution in this packet.

pass_if: clearly reads as a modern rechargeable LED camping lantern
handle, diffuser, lower-body control, body, and base are all plausible
does not drift into flashlight, candle, speaker, humidifier, thermos, desk lamp, smart speaker, or vintage kerosene lantern
product dominates the square frame as an ecommerce hero
background supports the product as a second layer
table or surface grounds the product without becoming a large distracting foreground
diffuser glow is warm and controlled
diffuser texture and product edges remain readable
dark premium body reads as metal or quality outdoor electronics, not toy plastic
no people, hands, faces, fire, open flame, smoke, or unsafe wet electronics
no readable text, logo, watermark, random letters, or fake brand marks
no extra product or packaging clutter
review notes can compare product-geometry transfer against Trial 001
failure, if any, is specific enough to update VisualJobContract, ShotPlan, ReviewPolicy, or broker binding

watch_items: product shrinks too much in frame
handle is cropped, detached, warped, or structurally impossible
control knob appears on the wrong part of the lantern or becomes random decoration
diffuser is blown out, dirty, mottled, or unreadable
object drifts into flashlight, speaker, candle, humidifier, thermos, desk lamp, or vintage kerosene lantern
scene becomes a camping landscape instead of a product-first hero image
foreground table becomes too large, bright, glossy, or distracting
text, logo, watermark, people, hands, fire, smoke, or extra lanterns appear
